listed.text: Trunk and Roots: trunk: the continuation chain from the seedling: at each fork it runs on through the thickest child; structural roots at the trunk base: 5, flaring into the soil
Leaders: leaders: chains seated on the trunk chain; a low fork gives several stems
Branches: branches: chains seated on a leader
Twigs: twigs: chains seated on a branch; slender and zigzag, from the relay of a side bud each year
Shoots: shoots: every chain of a higher order: the youngest shoots, which carry most leaves

Redbud.done: At the page camera the crown reads as a loose, irregular dome of leaf clusters, a little taller than wide, on a short trunk that forks low and flares into the soil. Gaps between the clusters show dark limbs. Every limb sits on its parent and every leaf on its shoot.

view.why: the bar scene frames the whole 5 m tree, and a person stands back about one tree height to see a small tree whole
view.farthest_why: the full tree hands over to Redbud_Lite at about four tree heights, 20 m (the README's Nearest view), so it is not seen from farther

Redbud_Lite.done: At the page camera the same loose, irregular dome of leaf clusters on a short, low-forking trunk. Its leaves are fewer and plainer, so many copies stay cheap. Every limb sits on its parent and every leaf on its shoot.

view.why: the copy for scenes that repeat many trees, seen as a backdrop from about four tree heights, where single leaves no longer read
view.farthest_why: an estimate from how it is used, to be confirmed: the far end of the backdrop of many trees seen from the scene's camera; the README says only where the backdrop begins
